files.semantic_notes: F013 composed closing catches application fault/cancellation, always awaits internal close, preserves single-fault identity and ordered AggregateException on dual failure. Initializing composition and lease registration/release remain otherwise unchanged.

F014 provider Validate adds five positive-range guards and whole-millisecond native checkpoint timer limit, then preserves inherited validation. F016 captures ConfigureOptions delegate at generation creation before client factory use; normal Build materializes Blob container before future processor creation. Standalone lazy Blob generation is explicitly outside scope.

F016 builder copies all nine ReceiveSettings fields into getter-only nested snapshot and overwrites receive-settings payload with the same snapshot. Snapshot is taken in constructor before ApplySpecifications; whether valid specification-stage settings mutation should be included remains a concrete adjacent contract question.

F017 all four deferred typed/batch/value/batch-value core overloads await shared resolution via WaitAsync(caller token), then await actual delivery; four pipe-free overloads delegate. Ready fast path retains direct downstream cancellation contract, shared resolution cancellation remains owned by GetProducer caller. Header transfer adapter unchanged.

One theory covers ten closing combinations with exact ordering, internal-entry gate, pending wait, fault object identity, cancellation token/status and ordered dual-fault aggregate. Finally releases gate, joins real closing task without masking primary assertion with expected fault, and releases SDK event lease twice.

Six policy theories cover 9 provider-invalid, 3 inherited-invalid, 5 timer-positive, 2 selection-positive, 7 retained-setting mutations and 2 options-replacement cases = 28 cases. Normal public DI/build/composition validation, exact nine-field snapshot and exact conservative MessageLimits payload; client supervisor path tests actual SDK properties without startup. Timeout bounds only, cleanup awaits stop.

Three producer theories cover eight precanceled, eight later-canceled and sixteen ready/pending positive routes = 32 cases. Genuine held consume context from normal in-memory handler; strict producer SPI verifies exact formal type/argument/token/header transfer and awaits gated delivery. Canceled waiter isolation verified while live waiter and shared source remain pending; finally joins both wrapper tasks and downstream operation.

Capture helper decorates normal public registration factory/specification, forwards public interface calls through DispatchProxy while unwrapping original exception identity, observes exactly one actual production context via ConnectReceiveEndpointContext. Explicit exact MessageLimits payload projection compensates proxy loss of internal runtime host interface; helper neither generates second context nor supplies ReceiveSettings/client factory.

Entire 92-row requirement projection personally read; exact parsed equality preserves all 82 Package01 rows and appends ten rows matching all new Closing/Policy/Producer methods, no helper test entry and no duplicates. Formatting expanded old rows without semantic changes.

Frozen mutation runner builds 19 distinct source mutants, requires exact native receipt command/cwd/log SHA, nonzero exit and specific assertion or independently exact fractional timer rejection. F016 intentionally excluded from first suite; resume preserves existing receipts with same owned fixture SHA. Finally restores every owned original and removes new fixtures; whole 6209 validation requires separate receipt.

Frozen settings runner copies four fixtures including normal context capture, verifies unchanged fixture hashes before each 11 distinct field/live alias/options mutants, exact nine cases and expected count. Boolean failure sentinel is intentionally excluded from numeric count check via type(failures) is int after receipt classifier interruption; all receipts command/log SHA remain bound. Finally restores originals and removes fixtures.

Entire changelog personally read, current hash frozen; exact Package08 baseline delta is one blank plus four bounded F013/F014/F016/F017 lines. Existing source-review/history entries untouched; claims refer completed normal Build generation and per-caller waiting.
Global usings expose production public Advanced/Configuration/EventHubs SPI and no private seam. Namespace resolution is shared by all owner tests.
Assembly disables xUnit parallelization for shared local emulator/SDK tests; no skipped or conditional activation is introduced.

Checkpoint unit-side SDK model-factory tests verify newest-offset fallback order, exhausted failure recovery and canceled full-queue admission without provider writes; task gates and awaited disposal bound accepted events. Distinct positive fallback paths and lifetime/admission token separation are asserted.

Six real local integration tests cover exact 100 ordered same-partition batch, observed first-fault continuation, exact retry metadata, partition health transition, gated checkpoint writes and real custom container/producer options. Canonical fixture plus run markers isolate messages; awaited bus stop and fixture cleanup are shared controls.

Blob SDK fakes cover complete container URI for anonymous/token/shared-key modes, no creation for existing container, canceled token forwarding on creation and exact failure identity. Public virtual SDK methods/model factories define mock convention; no private introspection.

Three ownership tests cover duplicate endpoint pairs, independent groups, rejected host/storage/options replacement and recovering invalid inputs before first build. Positive actual namespace/client identifier, delivery, checkpoint blob and discarded-callback counts bind configuration to real local provider behavior.

Existing deferred producer suite has two eight-case theories for resolution/delivery success/failure and canceled resolution. Held normal consume context and strict public producer SPI assert exact metadata, argument type/identity, headers and pipe overrides. This is adjacent positive fault/cancellation coverage for F017; old teardown helper differs from new explicitly joined cleanup.

Four local integration tests cover dynamic endpoint receiving pre-connect exact envelope, two typed-bus rider routing, inbox/outbox bus-serializer identifiers/cardinality and typed/untyped send-filter payloads with next completion. Run markers, actual provider delivery and awaited stop define the normal public consumer routes.

Four header tests assert null constructor guard, present/blank identifiers, omission of null application values and identifier-case versus exact application-key lookup. SDK EventData public properties are direct positive metadata controls.

Four real SDK/local interop tests verify raw envelopes/default serializer, publish-to-bus source/initiator, provider payload presence and ordered sequence/offset/time for two same-key events. Run-isolated state, actual bus/rider delivery and checkpoint-aware stop are full closure inputs.

Two admission tests with three cases verify observer content-type mutation rejection on single and either batch item, absence of PostSend and exact fault identity/cardinality. Real local provider and awaited bus lifecycle support admission controls independent of F017 waiting boundary.

Three processor lease tests use SDK protected event raisers and public builder callback SPI to verify registration/detachment order across reuse, duplicate lease/null guard and required constructor dependencies. The success-close ordering is a positive compatibility control for F013.

Fifteen batch-send methods with parameterized routing/partial-failure cases assert preflight before provider work, exact mixed-route batch order, route activity tags, rollover cardinality, every SDK model-factory batch disposal, provider confirmation flags and cancellation ownership. Explicit cleanup failure cases protect primary provider cause and continuing already confirmed delivery.

Three cache tests verify gated single-flight identity, retry after exact factory fault and cached usage/token/payload delegation plus disposal. These are public producer cache lifetime controls adjacent to shared F017 resolution; no private producer fields are read.

Three real delivery tests assert exact ten-item envelope/cardinality, full single-envelope addresses/structured header and bus-send-observer pre/post stages for a run marker with foreign-message positive isolation. Normal provider resolution and consumer roundtrip define public delivery controls.

Eight producer-outcome methods cover single/batch observer faults, throwing logger, partial retry only pending contexts, preserved confirmed spans and final exact provider failure. Recorded transport SPI intentionally models confirmation/retry outcomes and is separate from native broker tests; test AsyncLocal logger restored in finally.

Three resolution tests verify null/blank guards, exact topic entity address/cancellation forwarding and harness scope provider resolution. Strict public DispatchProxy rejects unintended calls; canceled token positive forwarding does not claim provider itself ignores cancellation.

Five receive admission tests verify capacity release and partial confirmation faults after pending/executor failures, canceled admission, accepted work surviving later stop and faulted accepted work recovery. Public task executor/lock-context SPI fakes directly exercise queue admission ownership.

Five full local saga/lifecycle tests cover state-derived production, both fault activity arities, callback-delivery ordering for all four partitions and consumer/producer restart generations. Exact initiator IDs, generation counters, close reasons and cardinality are asserted on real canonical fixture delivery.

Two concrete pending-confirmation regression controls: delivery cancellation affects one matching partition/offset while other partitions and replacement awaiters complete; processor lifetime cancellation cancels every open confirmation and preserves prior successful/faulted terminal task results, exact token and fault identity. SDK checkpoint delegate throws if incorrectly called.

Actual ProcessorLockContext and protected SDK partition callbacks: canceled delivery closes without checkpoint while another partition persists its offset and lease is reusable; shutdown waits for an in-flight gated checkpoint before success. Dispose cancels lifetime, joins closing tasks and always disposes lock/CTS; outer log context restored.

Canonical local fixture validates EventHubs options, constructs emulator and separate run-owned Blob endpoints, gives each purpose a bounded Azure-valid unique container prefix, configures public host/storage and zero-retry raw producer; Dispose enumerates and deletes only its own prefix with operation timeout.
